notes.title: Time To Wake Up is releasing in 2026!
notes.content: [p]Hello, everyone! [/p][p][/p][p]We hope this very first update finds you well! [/p][p][/p][p]We just wanted to let you know that we have now received full production [b]funding for Time To Wake Up[/b], meaning that we can release the game next year in 2026![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44373924/b2600f0e14dbb8a34035ff9a1a7c0db31675e29a.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Right now, we're in early production, working our way up to alpha, which we define as follows: the full game is playable from start to finish, everything works, but not every nook and cranny looks or sounds pretty yet.[/p][p][/p][p]That's it. We just wanted to inform you that Time To Wake Up is really releasing next year! Given we're a small team, we will limit announcements to the essentials, but expect to hear more from us the closer we get to release![/p][p][/p][p]How excited are you for the release? What would you love to learn about Time To Wake Up? Let us know![/p][p][/p][p]Have a nice rest of your week![/p][p][/p][p][/p]
